newsitem.title: USA: Record companies sue for copyright infringement.
newsitem.headline: Record companies sue for copyright infringement.

text.p: Recording companies sued a company operating an Internet site at "ftp://208.197.0.28/" (the "Internet company") for the infringement of copyrighted sound recordings, said a complaint filed in the Southern District Court in New York.

In its complaint, the recording companies, Sony Music Entertainment Inc, A&M Records Inc, Arista Records Inc, Atlantic Recording Corp, Capitol Records Inc, Island Records Inc, London Records, Maverick Recording Co, MCA Records Inc, a unit of Seagram Co Ltd and Warner Brothers Records Inc, a unit of Time Warner Inc, said the Internet company created and maintained a site for the sole purpose of reproducing, distributing and exchanging unauthorized copies of copyrighted sound recordings.

The recording companies alleged that the Internet company had copied over 100 sound recordings which it then made available for the reproduction and distribution to millions of Internet users worldwide.
The recording companies are seeking an injunction against the Internet company's unauthorized copying and distribution and damages for the infringements which have occured to date.
